diagnosis.precise_failure: Actual scheme-name readback did not equal the original; flags/HC-off/colors restoration and unique final free succeeded.
diagnosis.no_unjustified_fix: The original snapshot copied empty text before SET; the final snapshot copied 高对比黑色. Existing comparison correctly detects this observed difference. Merely removing the scheme comparison would not prove exact restoration. No extra SET variant, registry/theming call or unbounded retry is justified by this evidence.
diagnosis.possible_explanation_not_proven: Enabling with the originally empty/default scheme may lead the platform to resolve or retain a named scheme. The official member/API description does not establish that this explains this run, nor authorize relabeling the resulting mismatch as equal.
diagnosis.bounded_route_conclusion: Keep whole run FAIL and retain actual HC UI/keyboard and buffer-release subcontracts separately. Exact original scheme-state restoration is not demonstrated. Do not rerun the unchanged large HC path or stack APIs; if exact environment restoration remains required, identify an official supported blank/default-scheme contract or a genuinely different supported environment before another native route.
diagnosis.product_conclusion: This mismatch occurs in TEST environment restoration, not an observed production Move/Resize/GUI business failure. Product GUI behavior actually observed above remains scoped evidence.

clock_scope: Driver tick values describe its own sequential API/breadcrumb endpoints. Selected JSONL rows are not a shared Raw/WinEvent native order. BMPs are actual retained screen regions; no physical display latency claim.

official_contract.meaning: System allocates the GET scheme string and documents LocalFree; SET supplies all members. This alone does not prove an empty former scheme can be round-tripped after resolving a named HC scheme.

acceptance_limit: Original FAIL retained; scoped visible controls/keyboard, HC-bit transitions and native buffer release can be reused at their actual identities. WholeHC exact restoration, M10-F05, fullV1,200%DPI and humanUAT are not accepted.
